content.text: cannot connect to the backtest daemon at <daemon-addr>: this hub REQUIRES authentication (it advertises the `auth` feature) but this box holds no datahub key, the pair it verifies. To read, file its observe key (VIKE_DATAHUB_OBSERVE_KEY) here: `vike-cli backend connect HOST --manual` takes it as the third stdin line. `vike-cli datahub setup` on the datahub's box mints the pair, and `vike-cli secrets copy-hub-keys` carries the pair to a project that writes (start it with `vike-backend backtesthub --addr`)
